sections.label: ASSISTANT
sections.content:
History confirms: the ball (c) **never moved** in all 31 actions — SPACE at (12,8),(12,28),(44,28) and MOUSE at (2,37),(5,37) all did nothing. The paddle is the only movable object. After RESET, paddle is back at initial (left 12, row 16, center 21) — aligned with **arch1's** opening (20-23), not the ball (37).
Revised world model:
- Paddle = player (arrows), rows 12-46, left-edge step 4, starts left 12/row 16.
- Ball (c+M) static at cols 36-38, rows 1-6. Arches (Y) static at rows 52-59, openings cols 20-23 (arch1) & 44-47 (arch2).
- Timer = hard countdown (~32 actions). game over → level RESET (retry), not run end.
- Goal likely: get ball into an arch. Trigger for ball fall still unknown. I never tried SPACE while aligned with arch1, nor MOUSE on an arch.
Let me probe the most likely triggers: SPACE at initial (arch1-aligned) position, then observe.

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(fr):
    b=p=None
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='c': b=n['boundary']
        if n['color']=='b': p=n['boundary']
    return b,p
b0,p0=snap(current_frame)
print("before:", b0, p0, "timer", current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[0].count('N'))
r=action(['SPACE'])
print("after SPACE:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('game_over'))
b1,p1=snap(current_frame)
print("after:", b1, p1, "timer", current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[0].count('N'))
print("ball moved:", b0!=b1, "paddle moved:", p0!=p1)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
